# Doppler Gotchas

> Known Doppler patterns that cause silent failures or hard-to-debug errors.

## Entries

- [Renaming a Doppler secret without exposing its value](rename-secret-without-exposing-value.md): Doppler's API rename needs the value; pipe get --plain --raw into set --no-interactive, cmp, then delete the old name, discarding output. MEDIUM.
- [doppler configs tokens --json prints null for a config with no tokens](configs-tokens-json-null.md): iterate `json.load(...) or []`. LOW.
- [doppler secrets set prints the values it set](doppler-secrets-set-prints-the-values-it-set.md): piping a secret via stdin still echoes it in the table; discard stdout and list with --only-names. MEDIUM.
- [Doppler silently disables a Railway sync when Railway rejects its token, so prd writes stop deploying](doppler-silently-disables-a-railway-sync-when-railway-rejects-its-token-so-prd.md): When Railway revokes or rejects the token behind a Doppler Railway integration, "Doppler Bot" disables the integration and every sync on it, with no alert, so a write to the synced config no longer… HIGH.
- [Doppler's activity log records secret changes only, never reads; only per-secret Access Logs show reads](doppler-s-activity-log-records-secret-changes-only-never-reads-only-per-secret.md): The Doppler workplace activity log (`doppler activity`, dashboard Activity) records changes only, never reads, so it cannot answer "who read this secret" during an incident. HIGH.
- [Each Doppler dashboard save triggers its own Railway sync and deploy round; batch edits into one save](each-doppler-dashboard-save-triggers-its-own-railway-sync-and-deploy-round-batch.md): With a Doppler -> Railway sync, every separate save in the Doppler dashboard is its own sync and its own Railway deploy round across all synced services. MEDIUM.
- [A new Doppler secret reaches no Railway service that uses per-variable shared references until you add the reference first](a-new-doppler-secret-reaches-no-railway-service-that-uses-per-variable-shared.md): When Doppler syncs to Railway shared variables and each service references them one by one (`${{shared.NAME}}`), a brand-new Doppler secret lands in shared variables but reaches no service until a… HIGH.
